description: This file contains extension methods for CanvasWindowController, providing helper functions for session key sanitization, JavaScript string literal encoding, handling stored window frame states, and related utilities.

classes.name: CanvasWindowController
classes.description: A controller class managing a canvas window, extended with helper functions for session management and frame restoring.

methods.name: sanitizeSessionKey
methods.description: Sanitizes a session key string by trimming whitespace and replacing disallowed characters with underscores.

methods.name: jsStringLiteral
methods.description: Encodes a string as a JSON-compatible JavaScript string literal.

methods.name: jsOptionalStringLiteral
methods.description: Returns a JavaScript string literal for a non-nil string or 'null' for nil.

methods.name: storedFrameDefaultsKey
methods.description: Generates a UserDefaults key for storing the window frame for a given session key.

methods.name: loadRestoredFrame
methods.description: Loads a previously saved window frame from UserDefaults if valid.

methods.name: storeRestoredFrame
methods.description: Stores the current window frame into UserDefaults for a given session key.
